entities.name: Ryang Chun-hwa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ryang Chun-hwa is a North Korean weightlifter. She competed at the 2012 Summer Olympics in the Women's 48 kg, winning the bronze medal. Ryang represents the April 25 Sports Team. She won the silver medal at the 2011 Summer Universiade.
